title: Launch a truck
sourceDocs: DTP TS tickets via Glean, Aug 4 – Nov 2, 2026

ls_p0.text: Confirm in ATMS that your truck has an order leaving {terminal}
ls_p0.help: In ATMS, find the order departing {terminal} and check the truck ID on it matches the truck in front of you.
ls_p0.done_when: ATMS shows an order departing {terminal} with this truck's ID on it.

ls_p1.text: Confirm the truck is in the correct environment
ls_p1.help: In Slack, send yourself a DM with this command: /checkenv. Once the truck is in the correct environment, you will need to perform a Cold Start.
ls_p1.done_when: /checkenv confirms the truck is in the correct environment.

ls_esc_env.text: Stop. The truck is in the wrong environment. Open a VRE thread and paste the summary below.
ls_esc_env.handoffNote: Request: put this vehicle in the correct cloud environment. Once it's in the correct environment, the VO will perform a Cold Start. Reply in thread when done.

ls_p2.text: Start the truck and bring computes up
ls_p2.help: Turn on pECU (then rECU, if present). Use shore power and ethernet if available. Start the engine and boot the Aurora Driver.
ls_p2.done_when: TApp shows the truck connected and both logging-disk lights are lit.
ls_p2.source: Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Launching 3.1; Truck prep 5.1–5.2

steps: Check every power cutoff switch is in the run position.
Check pECU (and rECU, if present) are on.
Wait for TApp to reconnect.
ls_c1.source: Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Truck prep 5.2 (check power cutoff switches before escalating to VRE)

ls_c2.text: Cold start once, then recheck TApp
steps: TODO: platform cold-start sequence from SOP.
Wait for the truck to reconnect to the tool before doing anything else.
Step back through TApp and retry the launch.
ls_c2.source: TS: DTP-104301 · launch.json ln_cs platform sequences · VO site practice (Oct 2026)
ls_c2.help: Do one cold start only. In DTP-113007 and DTP-112133, repeated cold starts didn't help because the truck was in the wrong environment.

steps: Swap stack to idle via TAPP or Scout.
Apply parking brake.
Press and hold the Compute Power Button for 5 seconds. PWR indicators blink red.
Wait for both PWR indicators to slow-blink green.
Press and hold the Engine Start Button to turn off the vehicle.
Turn the primary battery bank switch OFF.
Turn the redundant (secondary) battery bank switch OFF.
Ensure both TMS LEDs are off. If on, cycle the battery switches again.
Wait a minimum of 3 minutes.
Ensure the DBW Disconnect is in the up/released position.
Turn the redundant (secondary) battery bank switch ON.
Connect shore power if needed.
Turn the primary battery bank switch ON.
Shore power only: press Engine Start twice. Vehicle power: hold the Engine Start Button.
Ensure both TMS LEDs show amber or green.
Press the drive height recall button.
Press the Compute Power Button for 1 second. It fast-blinks green, then goes steady.
If it takes more than 10 minutes to boot, consult VRE.
Swap to AV stack via TAPP or Scout.
Wait for the truck to reconnect to the tool before doing anything else.
Perform System Shut Down.
Apply parking brake and place transmission in Neutral.
Swap stack to idle via TAPP or Scout.
Turn ignition key OFF. The LED stays solid green for about 150 seconds, flashes red for about 10 seconds, then turns off.
Wait a minimum of 3 minutes after the LED is off.
Perform System Start Up.
Ensure the DBW Cutoff Switch is in the up/released position.
Engine power: start the engine and keep the ignition key in ON.
Shore power: confirm the shore power switch is off, connect shore power to the vehicle DC receptacle, turn the shore power switch on, then turn the ignition key to ON.
Ensure the Compute Power Button is flashing once per second (system ready to boot).
Press and release the Compute Power Button. The LED fast-blinks green, then burns steadily.
Swap to AV stack via TAPP or Scout.
Wait for the truck to reconnect to the tool before doing anything else.
Perform System Shut Down.
Apply parking brake and place transmission in Neutral.
Swap stack to idle via TAPP or Scout.
Turn ignition key OFF.
If on shore power: turn the shore power unit switch OFF and disconnect shore power from the vehicle.
Wait a minimum of 2 minutes.
Perform System Start Up.
Press the DBW Disconnect switch.
Start the engine. If on shore power: plug in shore power and turn the key to ON for 5 seconds.
Immediately release the DBW Disconnect button and ensure it is in the up/released position.
Wait for both PWR indicators on the LSI to slow-blink green.
Press the Compute Power Button for 1 second. PWR indicators fast-blink green, then burn steadily.
If the system takes more than 10 minutes to boot, consult VRE.
FG2.1 only: perform the TBS check.
Swap to AV stack via TAPP or Scout.
Wait for the truck to reconnect to the tool before doing anything else.

ls_esc_conn.text: Truck won't connect after the switch check and one cold start.
ls_esc_conn.handoffNote: Check the vehicle's cloud environment first. In three recent tickets, 'not connecting' turned out to be the wrong environment, and a cold start fixed it after VRE changed it.

ls_disk1.text: Reseat both logging disks and power cycle
steps: Only swap or reseat disks in the idle stack.
Reseat both logging disks.
Power cycle the computes and check both disk lights.
ls_disk1.source: Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Launching 3.1; Truck prep 5.2

ls_disk2.text: Reseat the disks one more time
steps: Reseat both logging disks again.
Check both disk lights.
ls_disk2.source: Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Truck prep 5.2 (if still not lit, reseat again and escalate to VRE)

ls_esc_disk.text: Logging disk light still off after two reseats.

ls_build.text: Build ID TApp shows for this truck
ls_build.help: It goes in the TS thread if you need one. Skip if you can't see it.

ls_p3.text: Check TApp for software update and calibration
ls_p3.help: Search the Trip ID or truck number. Tasks marked Required must be done; Suggested ones are optional. Run a Required update on ethernet; a cold start follows it.
ls_p3.done_when: No Required software update or calibration task is left open.
ls_p3.source: Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Launching 3.2 and Appendix (Calibration); DR-12112 (Required/Suggested labels)

variants.help: If the truck has Remote Software Deploy turned on, pull software through TApp, not Scout. Leave Scout alone during the launch workflow unless your VO task says otherwise. Required tasks must be done; Suggested ones are optional.

ls_p4.text: Confirm the trip is ready in TApp
ls_p4.help: The order must be Confirmed in ATMS for this truck. In TApp, open the Trips tab and find the trip.
ls_p4.done_when: TApp's Trips tab shows this trip on this truck, dated today.
ls_p4.source: TS: DTP-98931, DTP-109883; Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Launching 2.3

options.label: Says truck already has active trip

ls_t1.text: Look in the Trips tab, not the truck card
steps: Open the Trips tab in TApp.
Search the Trip ID.
ls_t1.source: TS: DTP-107741, DTP-97920 (workaround: navigate to the Trips tab)

ls_t2.text: Check TApp is set to the trip's terminal
steps: In ATMS, check the trip's origin terminal. It should be {terminal}.
In TApp Settings, set your terminal to match.
Refresh and search again.
ls_t2.source: TS: DTP-110377 (workaround: check location in ATMS, change location), DTP-111917; Terminal App Guide (Aug 2026), Settings

ls_esc_disp_trip.text: The trip still isn't showing. This is a Dispatch fix, not a TS thread.
ls_esc_disp_trip.handoffNote: Ask Dispatch to check: the order is Confirmed (DTP-98931); the departure date is today (DTP-109883); the trip type is SVO, not Manual, since manual trips don't show in TApp (DTP-112205, DTP-107543); recreate the trip if it's in ATMS but not TApp (DTP-109516).

steps: Refresh TApp.
If the old trip still shows active, stop. Don't retry force land; it keeps failing.

ls_esc_stale.text: A stale trip is blocking this one. VRE has to clear it.
ls_esc_stale.handoffNote: Likely ask: move the stack to IDLE, then refresh TApp (DTP-111692), or clear the blocking trip with find-blockers (DTP-102071).

ls_esc_disp_done.text: The order shows completed before this leg ran. Dispatch has to fix the order.
ls_esc_disp_done.handoffNote: Multi-leg order: ask Dispatch to move the order to the right stage for this leg (DTP-111695). Also check that the departure date is today (DTP-109883).

ls_p51.help: Start the task, ideally with the truck on ethernet. If a software download is running, TApp says so; it can take up to 45 minutes.
ls_p51.done_when: Prepare the Aurora Driver and Trip Data Sync show complete.

ls_tds1.text: Retry Prepare the Aurora Driver on ethernet
steps: Connect the truck to ethernet.
Retry Prepare the Aurora Driver once from TApp.
ls_tds1.source: TS: DTP-108879 (workaround: reset Prepare Aurora Driver V2 and try again, ideally on ethernet), DTP-110193, DTP-110294; Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Launching 3.5

ls_esc_tds.text: Trip Data Sync still fails after a retry on ethernet.
ls_esc_tds.handoffNote: Include the exact error text from TApp (e.g. SYSTEM_READINESS_GENERAL_ERROR, DOWNSTREAM_SERVICE_ERROR).

ls_dep1.text: Let the software pull finish, then retry
steps: Check the software update task in TApp.
When it shows complete, retry Prepare the Aurora Driver.

ls_esc_disp_atlas.text: The error says to request support and not to retry. Dispatch regenerates the trip.
ls_esc_disp_atlas.handoffNote: Ask Dispatch to regenerate the external trip with a valid pickup and drop-off; that moved the trip back to Preparing and cleared the atlas error (DTP-109242).

ls_esc_release.text: Permission check failed: software not of release.
ls_esc_release.handoffNote: Include the build ID and the trip's expected release. Past fixes needed TS to check the release label on the truck's software.

ls_p52.text: Enter weight, KPRA, and tire type
ls_p52.help: Let TApp swap stacks first. Enter gross and axle 1–3 weights from the scale ticket, KPRA, and tire type, then tap to sign. NVO: a second TO, ATOS, or Lead confirms the weight entry.
ls_p52.done_when: TApp confirms the submission and the values match the scale ticket and trailer.

ls_wm1.text: Wait for the AV stack, then resubmit
steps: Watch the stack status until it reads Autonomous.
Resubmit weight and KPRA once.
ls_wm1.source: TS: DTP-109799 (root cause: stack was in IDLE when submitted), DTP-110039, DTP-110828; Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Launching 5.1

ls_esc_wm.text: Still 'incorrect operating mode' with the stack in Autonomous.
ls_esc_wm.handoffNote: Likely ask: reset the task to the Preparing stage (DTP-109799 workaround).

ls_esc_spin.text: Weight and KPRA submit times out.
ls_esc_spin.handoffNote: Include the error if TApp shows one (e.g. SIGNAL_TIMEOUT).

ls_esc_bobtail.text: Known bug: TApp can't submit weight for bobtail.
ls_esc_bobtail.handoffNote: Fix in progress per DTP-112675 (submit platform weight from config for bobtail).

ls_p53.help: Confirm every item in TApp. Gate open, Drivewyze device mounted, charged, and logged in. SVO: doors and hatches closed and locked, headlights on.
ls_p53.done_when: Every Safety Requirement is checked and the step is finished in TApp.

ls_p54.done_when: TApp shows no diagnostics (service actions) for this truck.
ls_p54.source: Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Launching 7.3; Terminal App Guide (Aug 2026), Glossary (Service Actions)

ls_esc_diag.text: Diagnostics are present. The SOP sends these to VRE.
ls_esc_diag.handoffNote: List each diagnostic exactly as TApp shows it.

ls_p55.help: On the pad: immobilize (parking brake, wait 4 seconds, Neutral), chock, press the Standby toggle. Then remove chocks, check no one is within 4 ft, and follow TApp's launch instructions.
ls_p55.done_when: Autonomy engages and TApp shows the trip departing.

options.label: No ready state on the pad

variants.help: Peterbilt: do the TBS check first (repeat it any time the engine was turned off and on; !tbscheck in Slack). Then immobilize (parking brake, wait 4 seconds, Neutral), chock, and press the map-pin button. Remove chocks, check no one is within 4 ft, and follow TApp's launch instructions.
On the pad: immobilize (parking brake, wait 4 seconds, Neutral), chock, and press AUR AUTH on the dash. Then remove chocks, check no one is within 4 ft, and follow TApp's launch instructions.

steps: Tap the truck card in TApp.
Both Localization and Launch Position must read Gained. All tasks showing complete isn't enough.

ls_rs2.text: Line up on the pad again
steps: Make sure you're on the launch pad itself, not in front of it or at a staging spot.
Line up with the painted lines until TApp shows a valid launch position.
Immobilize again: parking brake, wait 4 seconds, Neutral.
ls_rs2.source: Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Launching 6.3; TS: DTP-109800, DTP-96816, DTP-110741, DTP-105621

steps: Drive at least 165 ft with at least one 90° turn. Avoid unnecessary stops.
Return to the pad, line up, and check both statuses read Gained.
ls_rs3.source: Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Launching 6.2; TS: DTP-107859, DTP-110850, DTP-112377

ls_rs4.text: Check the trailer type and length in TApp
steps: Compare the trailer type and length in TApp to the trailer you're pulling.
If either is wrong, correct it and tap to sign again (only possible before launch).
ls_rs4.source: TS: DTP-113026 (trailer entered as wrong type); Terminals SOP 500-009358-01 (rev Oct 13, 2026), Launching 5.2

ls_esc_ts.text: No listed fix for this. Open a TS thread with the summary below.

ls_esc_dispatch.text: This is an order or trip problem. Contact Dispatch, not TS.

ls_stop.text: Stopped for a safety, hardware, or compute symptom. No fixes were tried.
ls_stop.handoffNote: Keep the truck immobilized (parking brake set, Neutral) and stay with it until VRE responds.
